source_section: Methods: Cell culture; Establishment of ex vivo models

recipe_anchor.note: The publication lists further supplements; this anchor is NOT the full chemical formulation. Consult the source rather than using this abbreviated record as a medium definition.

missing_before_ocmi_model_release: Per-study/OCM confirmation of culture formulation and passage conditions
Exact basal-medium product variants and complete chemical-to-exchange mapping
Explicit serum/unknown-component assumptions and exchange-direction audit
Measured uptake rates or clearly labelled bounded sensitivity scenarios

current_pilot.interpretation: Counterfactual test of dependence on three unvalidated energy uptakes; not a reconstructed OCMI medium.

claim_limit: A concentration or gas fraction is not an uptake flux. The absence of an ingredient in this abbreviated record is not evidence of absence in the culture.
